items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I got this idea from my friend Owen Dodson

ctx.x: Joe Frazer, yes. Frazer, yes. Well since we're speaking, we have just mentioned a famous person let's go on to some others here.

I got this idea from my friend Owen Dodson (Louts?) and the poet, playwright who is writing a fascinating book which he calls "The Gossip Book". And it's filled with absolutely marvellous stories, quoted anecdotes, about the people from the world of art. And I'm wondering if you were to write such a book what some of your favorite anecdotes might be that you would include. Can you think of some stories that you just love? About very funny things that happened along the way? There must have been some. Miles Davis…
Miles was always funny. I can't ever think of anything that he would say except that he was funny.
